text:
jen: FYI - since ~07:35 UTC eu-west provisioning is failing for new GPU nodes. Boot logs show KMS handshake timeouts when the audit-pipeline sinks are enabled. Seen on 3/3 attempted nodes. rolling back keystore-mesh patch now. anyone oncall?
omar: i'm on it. can you paste the boot log snippet? @sre-oncall-bot please grab the incident channel
sre-oncall-bot: @jen incident created INC-2026-1135 - investigating (priority P2)
leo: quick grep of the node journal: `TLS handshake to 10.12.34.56:443 failed: connection reset by peer` - that's the privatelink endpoint for keystore-mesh
marie: confirmed. firewall rollout at 07:30 applied default-deny NACLs on subnet-a. that NACL denies outbound 443 to the keystore CIDR range.
jen: ahhh that default-deny patch slipped the privatelink CIDR. rolling a quick allow on subnet-a now
omar: can we do an SG allow instead? avoiding NAT egress holes reduces monthly bill. adding NAT exceptions spikes cost. prefer SG-based allowlist if possible
leo: note: privatelink targets live in infra-owned subnets; security asked us to avoid touching SGs for those. they requested NACL-only exceptions to keep ephemeral hosts locked down
marie: security here - we can add an explicit NACL rule but it must be audited. please annotate the change in the audit-pipe so compliance won't see a gap. propose tag `audit:keystore-allow-subnet-a` on the terraform change
jen: ack. patching now: `terraform apply -target=module.network.aws_network_acl_rule.allow_keystore` - adding audit tag in the change set
sre-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan approved by marie (apply queued)
omar: heads-up: once nodes join, the audit-forwarder backlog may cause CPU/io pressure on GPU hosts. last time a big backlog caused thrashing during bootstrap
leo: backlog is drained through audit-pipe -> S3 + ingestion lambda. if we flood it we'll hit ingestion QPS limits; that spikes lambda concurrency and S3 request cost. not huge per-event, but measurable at scale
jen: short mitigation: enable prefix prefetch in cloud-init so nodes don't do full fetch on churn. set `AUDIT_PREFETCH=on` in userdata for now
marie: long-term ask: pin keystore-mesh endpoints per-region instead of a global mesh. reduces cross-region egress and KMS decrypt latencies, also simplifies firewall rules
omar: agreed. i'll open a postmortem doc and include a rough cost delta. initial estimate: fallback NATing would cost ~+$2.2k/mo for eu-west traffic if we revert to NAT paths
leo: nodes are rejoining - current status 2/3 healthy after allow rule. still seeing occasional ephemeral decrypt fails but fallback is kicking in
jen: thanks. action items captured: (1) NACL allow + audit tag (done), (2) enable AUDIT_PREFETCH in cloud-init images (staging -> prod), (3) plan regional keystore pin and postmortem (omar). cc @sre-oncall-bot close when stable
sre-oncall-bot: INC-2026-1135 status -> resolving. monitoring for 30m then close.
